headline: Athens Stock Exchange: turnover and rebalancing ahead of upgrade
summary: The Athens Stock Exchange is recording higher turnover and index rebalancing, while anticipating its upgrade to developed market status. The input notes this contrasts with international pressures.
why: Upgrade to developed market status by index providers can attract passive and institutional inflows, which is why Greek equity trading and index changes draw investor attention.
